title: S138 later notes: owner-wait rows and pane wording

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Later notes from the S138 relay (run-20261026-175512-e95d, landed 34bb9f8), not fixed in that slice:
- The pane could replace "last heard" with "waiting since HH:MM" for awaiting-approval and paused (owner: dim it now, this later).
- "awaiting approval  19h00m  owner approval" repeats the word approval; hide the Wait text when it only restates the state (`internal/tui/overview.go` showsWait).
- "2 of 6 steps running" on an awaiting-approval row reads as active work; say "2 of 6 steps" for owner-wait states.
- While awaiting approval, the pane's stage bar and its "waiting" tail animate as if live (`internal/tui/relayboard.go`, boardLive); decide whether an owner wait should animate.
- Trial wall clock 45 min, 1 fix round.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: TestAwaitingApprovalRowShowsWaitingSince (the pane and detail show 'waiting since HH:MM' in place of 'last heard' for awaiting-approval, paused and ledger wait steps); TestWaitTextHiddenWhenItRestatesTheState ('awaiting approval' row has no 'owner approval' repeat); TestOwnerWaitRowsSayNOfMSteps (no 'running' wording: '2 of 6 steps'); TestOwnerWaitDoesNotAnimateTheStageBar (stage bar and the waiting tail identical across ticks, boardLive false for an owner wait); TestWaitSinceUsesTheStepUpdatedAt; goldens at 80x24 and 100x30.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Owner decision 2026-10-29: all four items. Tests first; re-anchor line numbers from the code (S142 landed the wait phase rendering: ledger wait steps, the ? glyph, 'ROLE waiting'). 1. For awaiting-approval, paused and a ledger step in phase wait, replace 'last heard' with 'waiting since HH:MM' (dim), using the wait step's updated_at or the record's paused time (relayboard.go, overview.go detail). 2. overview.go showsWait: hide the Wait text when it only restates the state ('awaiting approval  19h00m  owner approval' repeats approval). 3. Say 'N of M steps' (no 'running') for owner-wait states. 4. relayboard.go boardLive: no stage-bar or tail animation for an owner wait; the bar stays static. 5. docs/dashboard.md. UI slice: UI pass (r14). Files already listed; add internal/tui/runtree.go and progress.go if touched.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- go test -race -count=1 ./...
- go vet ./...
- gofmt -l .
- go test ./internal/tui -update, then review the golden diff
- slicer check
